updates.title: CMDRF Assistance Portal: Enhanced digital verification & real-time tracking now active.

updates.summary: All Taluk offices in Alappuzha district have integrated fast-track digital signatures for citizen certificate requests.

updates.summary: Training and technical support expanded for all district level government offices in Alappuzha.

updates.title: LRD Portal: Land Revenue Department services centralized for citizen access.
updates.summary: Access official land revenue circulars, tax payment details, and departmental contact directories.
